change: Five attempted-expression/target labels plus diagnostic-only fields in the existing resource observation live-child error and normal-exit-race records.

diagnostic_fields.operation: Literal attempted call expression set immediately before its original call; the sample_owned label includes live-group argument filtering. Full traceback disambiguates that expression and its nested helpers.
diagnostic_fields.target_PID: Existing adapter or currently queried direct-child PID for children/member; null for aggregate resource and byte observations.
diagnostic_fields.elapsed_seconds: Owner existing monotonic start; sampled inside the existing exception branch.
diagnostic_fields.owned_adapter_group_ID: Existing proc.pid; no new process query.
diagnostic_fields.owned_native_group_IDs: Sorted snapshot of the existing verified-owned set; no new ownership assertion/query.
diagnostic_fields.traceback: Full traceback.format_exc() from the original active exception, using the already imported module.

semantics_preserved: proc.poll() remains the first statement in the existing exception handler.
The live-child branch still sets resource_or_group_observation_failed and then follows identical stop_wait and cleanup.
The terminated-child branch still records an exit race and follows the same subsequent stop/deadline/cleanup logic.
PermissionError remains a failure; no EPERM exception special case, absence inference, zero substitution, ignored observation or fallback is introduced.
All original limits, inclusive bytes/growth accounting, no-retry guard, admission gate, caller/deck/native command and signal-capture scope are unchanged.
Extra diagnostics count against the existing full serialized receipt/output limits.
No saved original error, race record, source, receipt or failed namespace is rewritten.
proposed_source_is_not_a_fresh_launchabl: The unchanged P/S/D/O constants deliberately still name the immutable original protocol; existing output/no-retry and old source pins prevent reuse. This is a reviewable source proposal only.
next_gates: Independent saved failed-capture peer and root refusal/decision must be frozen and read before any execution is considered.
Independent source peer and root source review must assess the exact seven replacements.

Any later synthetic fixture, concrete successor source/actual/namespaces, identity/staging changes or native invocation requires a separate explicit authorization. No such preparation or execution is authorized by this packet.

optional_injection_fixture.reason: Omitted to keep the proposal minimal. A later explicitly authorized source-only fixture could inject a synthetic PermissionError at a labeled observation and separately exercise a direct-exit race without a native process.
